title: Orlando

vibeProfile.oneLine: A nobleman lives for centuries and wakes one day as a woman.

summary: A young Elizabethan nobleman named Orlando lives for over three centuries and, midway through, wakes up as a woman, moving through English history without aging in Woolf's most exuberant and playful book. Written as a mock biography and a love letter to Vita Sackville-West, it dances across time, gender and literary fashion with dazzling wit. Lighter than her great modernist novels but wonderfully inventive, it has become a landmark text for readers thinking about gender and identity.
whyReadIt: Woolf's most playful book, a mock biography of a hero who lives centuries and changes sex. Witty, exuberant, and ahead of its time.

funFacts.text: Woolf wrote it as a fantastical tribute to her lover, Vita Sackville-West.
